tool_args.rationale: The seven rows show concave growth near s_grad≈1 and large changes at off-baseline gradients, but do not identify how the gradient effect varies across substrate. A fine trajectory batch is justified to resolve that remaining ambiguity before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating-substrate response with gradient inhibition now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The only off-baseline gradient observations are two points at different substrate levels, so gradient dependence remains confounded with substrate response and the prior fit attempt failed before confirmation.
It is explicitly nuisance data and cannot resolve the response-law ambiguity.

That probe already supplied low- and high-gradient branches; another isolated branch comparison is less informative than a trajectory batch for separating substrate curvature from gradient dependence.
